key_idea: The copy looks exactly the same and sits right next to the first drawing.
steps: The pattern is a big square with a small blue square near its top, a little to the right.
The new copy goes right next to the first one, on its right side, at the same height.
In the copy, the small square is in the same place inside the new big square.
Point B is in the middle of the new small square, so it is on the new drawing.

choice_feedback.A: Point A is above the new big square, outside the drawing.
choice_feedback.C: Point C is past the right edge of the new big square.
choice_feedback.D: Point D is below the new big square.
choice_feedback.E: Point E is above the first drawing, not on the new one.
